title: Crypto Whale + Token Launch Tracker Input

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: tokens = scan new and trending DEX tokens via DexScreener (no key needed). wallets = monitor whale wallet transactions via Etherscan V2 multichain (bring your own key).

chains.title: Chains
chains.description: Chains to scan. DexScreener supports: ethereum, bsc, base, solana, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, avalanche, blast, linea. Etherscan V2 supports EVM chains only (no solana).

searchQueries.title: Search queries (tokens mode)
searchQueries.description: Token name or symbol searches via DexScreener. Example: ["AI", "PEPE", "meme"]. Leave empty to pull the latest token profiles feed instead.

tokenAddresses.title: Token addresses (tokens mode)
tokenAddresses.description: Exact token contract addresses to pull. One row per pair. Works across every DexScreener chain.

minLiquidityUsd.title: Minimum liquidity ($, tokens mode)
minLiquidityUsd.description: Filter out pairs with less than this much liquidity. Thin pools are rug risk. Typical floor is 25000 for retail, 250000 for sharp traders.

minVolume24hUsd.title: Minimum 24h volume ($, tokens mode)
minVolume24hUsd.description: Drop pairs with under this much 24h volume. 50000 filters dust. 1000000 only returns real momentum.

maxTokenAgeHours.title: Max token age (hours, tokens mode)
maxTokenAgeHours.description: Only return pairs created in the last N hours. 24 finds fresh launches. 168 (7 days) for weekly trend. 0 disables the filter.

sortBy.title: Sort order (tokens mode)
sortBy.description: How to sort results before pushing. volume24h is momentum. liquidity is size. priceChange24h is mover list. age picks newest first.

walletAddresses.title: Wallet addresses (wallets mode)
walletAddresses.description: EVM wallet addresses to monitor. One run pulls ERC20 transfers for every wallet on every chain in the chains list.

etherscanApiKey.title: Etherscan V2 API key (wallets mode)
etherscanApiKey.description: One key covers all EVM chains (Etherscan, Basescan, Arbiscan, BscScan, PolygonScan). Free tier gives 5 calls per second and 100k calls per day. Get one at etherscan.io/apis.

minTxValueUsd.title: Minimum tx value ($, wallets mode)
minTxValueUsd.description: Skip transfers worth less than this much USD. Price resolved via DexScreener per token. 100000 is the usual whale floor.

maxTxAgeHours.title: Max tx age (hours, wallets mode)
maxTxAgeHours.description: Only return transfers in the last N hours. 24 is a daily feed. 1 for near real time. 0 disables.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max items per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: Per chain + per query cap. Works as a cap on rows per DexScreener query and rows per wallet + chain pair.

maxItemsTotal.title: Maximum items per run
maxItemsTotal.description: Hard cap on rows pushed to the dataset per run. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip pair addresses and tx hashes pushed on previous runs. Stored in the key value store under SEEN_IDS.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. DexScreener and Etherscan rate limit per key or IP, so proxy helps only at very high volume.
